quest.title: Haunted Tales
quest.description: You encountered something peculiar in the first round, and the second is just about to begin...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey, you guys finally made it!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I was searching for hours. Still didn't see any sign of those three, so I decided to come back.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: How about you? Find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, it's kinda hard to explain...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We never managed to find those three, either.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: I see... So you came up empty-handed, too.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Well, it doesn't matter! I already came up with a new plan!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What plan?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Shinobu told me a saying after she got back from studying in Liyue. It went something like... "The something by day becomes..." Uhh, something by night?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "The hunter by day becomes the hunted by night."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's what I said! C'mon, keep up!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, I was so focused on scaring people last round that those three dressed up as ghosts caught me completely off guard.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But not this time! Oh no! I'll be hiding nearby and waiting for those three to emerge first, then I'll nail 'em with a surprise attack.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You two just gotta keep playing it natural and join the contest. Got it? Okay, see ya later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, Itto! Ugh, he ran off again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, his plan does make some sense at least... Let's go talk to the shrine maiden so we can join the second round.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Mwahahaha... Congratulations on winning the first round of the Test of Courage.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Now you're one step closer to the dark, messy truth. But is that really a good thing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, cut the nonsense! What we just saw was super terrifying!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Oh, really? Good to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Hearing the words "super terrifying" is exactly what all us event organizers would like to hear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh no, that's not what Paimon means! Something mysterious is also happening here, not just the event!

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: So what? You've heard the stories about the Test of Courage, haven't you?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Everyone who participates in the event faces a variety of emotions.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: People are afraid of seeing their innermost fears appear before them, yet they still seek the thrill of experiencing those fears.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: So isn't it natural for us to have things in the dark and deathly silent forest to help fulfill that experience?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Just like the grinning monster standing behind you right now, waiting for you to turn around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aaaah!!! Really!?

choices.text: She's messing with you.

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: Hehehe... I knew a little trick like that wouldn't be enough to scare you off.

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: So, congrats on passing this test. The second round of the Test of Courage will begin shortly.

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: Have you found your partner yet?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But don't we already have a partner from the last round...?

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: Yes, your team's outstanding effort certainly won you the last round.

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: So it's understandable that you'd want to pair up with your previous partner... But unfortunately, you must find a different partner for each round of the event.

response.speaker: Shrine Maiden
response.text: If you don't have a partner by the time the next round begins, then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, yeah, Paimon already knows! If we don't have a partner in time, then we'll be disqualified!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's ask around and see if there's anyone looking for a partner!

choices.text: There's nothing behind us.

talks.objective: Pick a partner out of the three contestants

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Don't freak out, boys! Whatever happens, I'll protect you!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: You're the best, Boss!

talks.objective: Begin the second round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: You appear to have found a partner. Let's see if you can repeat your luck from the first round.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Though, whether winning should be considered "good luck" or not is debatable, hehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Anyway, I will now reveal the item you'll be searching for in the second round of the Test of Courage.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: It's... a "fan."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A fan? You mean like the thing we use to keep cool when it's hot out?

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Correct. The fan was personally selected by the Yashiro Commissioner himself, and has been placed somewhere in the Chinju Forest.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: There will be signs to guide the way, but beware, the darkness that lurks in the forest is drawing nearer.

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Mwahahahaha... Remember, if you can't go on any further, you can always give up and live to see another day.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll never give up! Let's go!

talks.objective: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe! Look what we have here! Isn't this the fan we're looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, it has such a beautiful design on it. Are those fireworks? It seems to be for some sort of festival!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So now that we've found this fan, does that mean we've won the second round of the Test of Courage? Let's bring it back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank goodness it's over!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is there something else you need to take care of? How about I take the fan back, then?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thank you~! That would help.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: No need to thank me. It's been a blast doing the Test of Courage with you guys! I'd love to do it again!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So you must be Hitotsume Kozou!

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: Y—Yes!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, no need to be nervous. I'm Yoimiya, and I run Naganohara Fireworks.

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: Oh...! I once saw some Naganohara fireworks... Even though I was watching from a distance, they were still so beautiful, bursting across the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Really? Then the next time we meet, I'll bring some fireworks for us to launch together! It'll be fun!

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: Wow, really? Thank you very much... And, if I may ask, are you Lord Kaedehara Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, that's me, but I'm afraid that I'm no lord... just a wandering samurai.

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: I've seen you with your sword in the wilderness... You made quick work of many opponents with your amazing swordsmanship.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Ah, that must have been when I was trying to escape Inazuma... It wasn't as impressive as you make it seem. I had to face many trying situations before I was able to leave the islands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The head of the Kamisato Clan also lent me his assistance at the time. By the way, this is his sister.

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: Oh, so y—you must be the one and only Shirasagi Himegimi? What an honor...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: There's no need to be so formal...

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: I never imagined I'd ever meet someone as distinguished as you! I must be dreaming...!

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Hey, don't you want to go talk to them, too?

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I'm rather shy...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Really? That's strange, you seemed completely fine when we were chatting.

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: I'm not sure why, but I feel so relaxed when talking with you, General Gorou.

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: Actually, I'm the most timid of the three of us. I hid for days the last time someone tossed a stone into the river...

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: Ah! Sorry for rambling on. It's odd... I'm not normally like this...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: It's okay. You can't excel at everything. The important thing is to have the courage to change.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hey there, chatting away I see... Mind if I join you?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I've never seen a Kappa before.

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: H—Hello there.

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: Thank you for bringing so many amazing people to meet us, Itto.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha! It's nothing! Being the "The One and Oni" means being the best, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh — I should mention that, uh, I even have my own gang, and every member has a special title!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Classic Itto... There you go, bragging about yourself... again!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't confuse them! Everyone's here for the Test of Courage, not because you brought them here! Half the people here don't even know who you are!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hey! This is my moment, Paimon! Don't ruin it for me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Itto really isn't as cool as he claims to be.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #When it comes to having connections in Inazuma, nobody can beat Paimon and {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh yeah!? Alright, well then let's have a little contest and see who knows the most people!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sure! Bring it on, Bull-Chucker Beetle Boy!

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: Ahem... please don't fight. Actually, I think you're both really amazing.

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: And you also have a great friendship. Just like Lord Kamai and the samurai...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Haha, well, of course—

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Boss!!!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh, it's the boys!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Darn it! I was so caught up with the youkai that I forgot I was supposed to scare the daylights outta the gang!

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahem... hey fellas, look, I can explain, I—

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Boss, we're sorry!!!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Wait, what now?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru
dialogues.text: We shouldn't have ever doubted you, Boss. You were right!

dialogues.speaker: Akira
dialogues.text: Yeah, the Test of Courage is terrifying! Th—There are definitely ghosts here!!!

dialogues.speaker: Genta
dialogues.text: I still get shivers just thinking about it... But the thrill was kinda fun...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh... uh... hahaha well, I told you it would be an exhilarating experience, but noooo, none of you believed me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, no need to be too scared now. Let me tell you what's happening here...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: It turns out, there aren't any ghosts here, all the scary stuff you saw was just a little misunderstanding we had with the youkai.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Right?

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: Ah... Sorry, but I've never seen these three before.

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: I'm not sure where you've been or what you've seen, but I don't think it had anything to do with us...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: H—Hold on, little Youko... You're kidding, right? You know, now's really not the time for that!

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: N—No, I'm serious. I really don't know what's going on...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But if it wasn't you guys... does that mean there are real ghosts out here!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait a minute, we did meet some lady who was all dressed up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, that's right! Paimon assumed she was a youkai too, and we even played Akitsu Yuugei with her.

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: *gulp* I—I'm not sure who it was you met...

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: But we're the only three youkai who wanted to hold a festival here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! So she was a ghost?

dialogues.speaker: Mamoru, Akira, and Genta
dialogues.text: Ah, Boss! Save us!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Calm down! Everyone j—just calm down now!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: What's all the noise about?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, you're the Tenryou Commission's...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heizou!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: There's nothing to fear. Even if there really is a ghost, all your noise would drive it away.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Itto, you and your gang should go and inform the other contestants about the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, please come with me.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Paimon somehow feels a little better now that Heizou's here...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Could the rumors be true then? Do strange phenomena really happen every time the Test of Courage is held...?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayaka
dialogues.text: Please, be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Unease pervades the air, and fear is spreading.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Maybe this is the real Test of Courage...? It's already becoming an unforgettable experience for me.

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: "Recite this to yourself, keep your mind clear and at peace. Free your thoughts from spirits and ghosts"...

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: Those were Her Excellency's remarks in the directive. She once said, "There is nothing to be afraid of as long as your conscience is clear."

dialogues.speaker: Gorou
dialogues.text: If only Her Excellency were here. She would get to the bottom of all this in no time.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So is there really a ghost around here?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: I'm gonna go look for it. I've never seen a ghost before! Oh, how exciting!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I believe my lord had foreseen this situation...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: He has my absolute trust, but given Lady Ayaka is still here, we must get to the bottom of this as soon as possible.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Shh... this is one of my usual hiding spots. It's always safe here.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Let me show you a trick. Just cover your eyes, and the scary things will go away...

talks.objective: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Phew... this place should be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I can't believe I made it this far. Hey, did I get any taller?

choices.text: Uh, maybe a little.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? Ah, that's great!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Enough about that. Look! Isn't this the fan we're looking for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It has fireworks printed on it, so it must be for some kind of festival!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: So does that mean the second round of the Test of Courage is over now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep, seems like it. Haha, we've won again!

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Great. *yawn* Because I was just starting... to feel sleepy...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: In that case, I'll take the fan back with me and have a little nap. Just don't stay out here too long...

choices.text: I don't see any change.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Aww, how come...

talks.objective: Complete the second round of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Ah, this must be the fan we're looking for.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Seems we're the first to find it, too. Our luck's not so bad after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see... Oh, it has fireworks printed on it, so it must be for some sort of festival!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Paimon thought Ayato would choose a folding fan... You know, like the kind Ayaka usually uses.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: You're right, this fan doesn't appear to be something my lord would usually use...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Anyway, let's head back now that we've found it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, wonder if Itto's still out trying to capture those three from earlier. Paimon's a little worried about him... Why don't we have a look around?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hmm? Are you planning to stay here? Then allow me to take the fan back.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: But remember, you're only one round away from taking home the special prize! Make sure you get yourselves ready and give it your best shot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow Itto, you really captured them!
Seriously, why didn't you run when I told you?
What're you saying... We couldn't abandon you!
Yeah, that's right! So just get on with it... If you're gonna eat us, then you'll have to deal with all three of us!
We won't back down, even if... even if we're already in your stomach!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Who said we were going to eat you? Wait, are you the ghosts of something tasty?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And Itto, why're you so quiet all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hmm... I have a weird feeling that I've seen these three somewhere before...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ah, I know! These are all creatures from the Ultimate Youkai Field Guide that granny used to show me!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: There's Youko, Kappa, and Hitotsume Kozou! They're all youkai.

dialogues.speaker: Youko
dialogues.text: It sure took you long enough to notice.

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: Well, we recognized you right away! You're an oni, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
dialogues.text: According to legends, oni are grouchy, extremely strong, and crush other youkai into balls to eat them up!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Pfff! That's the most ridiculous thing I've ever heard! Who came up with that!?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Besides, you're the ones people are scared of! Hiding behind bushes and scaring people off the road, what are you trying to do here?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: #Don't think I didn't see you! ...Following {M#him}{F#her} around and conjuring up all sorts of weird, scary stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aha, so it was you three!

dialogues.speaker: Kappa
dialogues.text: No, we weren't trying to scare anyone. We were just trying to, uh...

choices.text: Go ahead, you can tell us.

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: Really? You're not mad?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even though you scared the daylights out of Paimon a few times, it doesn't seem like you were doing it on purpose.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's hear your side of the story and Paimon will decide whether or not to forgive you!

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: Ahem, well, the truth is... we were planning a festival.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: One hosted by the youkai, but humans are also welcome to attend.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean, the Mikawa Flower Festival?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, the festival that Ei mentioned!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Mikawa Flower Festival... huh, that does ring a bell.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah right, it used to be hosted by the top youkai. I heard it was supposed to be a lot of fun... I mean, not as fun as my Almighty Arataki Great and Glorious Drumalong Festival, but still...

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: Yes, the Mikawa Flower Festival is our aspiration... But we know that our festival doesn't deserve that name.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: The times of Hyakkiyakou are long gone, we're just a bunch of little youkai living in the wilderness.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: As you can see, we lack the necessary youkai powers to put on such a grand festival.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: But... we're determined to still reach out to humans and express our gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Gratitude? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Kappa
response.text: Mm-hmm. You see, we live in the wilderness and are frequently attacked by monsters.

response.speaker: Kappa
response.text: They would come and stir up trouble on our land, forcing us to hand over our food... Sometimes they would even get rough and leave us injured.

response.speaker: Kappa
response.text: But later, many human adventurers came into the wilderness and drove off the monsters, allowing us to live in peace.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, I get it now. You wanna repay the favor, but your powers are too puny!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, don't let it get to ya. You might be a bunch of pip-squeaks, but you're all solid youkai in my book!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So are you the ones who set up the Akitsu Yuugei game on the beach?

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: Yep, that was us! Have you tried it yet? Isn't it fun?

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: We drew inspiration from the legendary Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura. It took a lot of youkai power to set it up.

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: After that, we didn't have much youkai power left, so we set up some stalls in the forest to add to the festival atmosphere...

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: We were just following you to see your reactions.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is the Akitsu Yuugei really that important? Why did you spend all of your youkai power to build it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon would have taken {NICKNAME} for a big meal if you had set up more food stalls!

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: Really?

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: To be honest, we've never met a human before, so we had no idea what you would like...

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: We focused on building the Akitsu Yuugei because of a legend we heard.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ah, I know the one!

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: It's the story of youkai meeting a human during a festival hundreds of years ago.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: The Mikawa Flower Festival is meant to bring happiness to all who attend, and Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura is a symbol of friendship.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: That's why, when we decided to hold the festival here, setting up Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura was our first priority.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: Unfortunately, the real Akitsu Haz{RUBY#[S]Haneasobi}ura has been lost to time. What we created is a version of the game we heard about from a wandering merchant, so we changed the name to Akitsu Yuugei.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We heard that someone had been trapped in Akitsu Yuugei.

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: Yeah, but that wasn't us!

response.speaker: Kappa
response.text: We have no idea what could have gone wrong!

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: We closed Akitsu Yuugei a while ago and carefully checked it for any issues.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: But, we didn't find anything wrong with it... Maybe it was just some strange mishap caused by our unstable youkai power at the time.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hmm, they don't look like they're lying, and believe me, I know a liar when I see one! Maybe it really was just an accident.

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: After that incident, people stopped coming to the attraction.

response.speaker: Kappa
response.text: Later, a human man with blue hair appeared and walked around the area...

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: He had a piercing gaze, I almost felt like he could see us.

response.speaker: Youko
response.text: But then he turned and quickly left without saying anything.

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: It wasn't long before large numbers of people began coming to the Chinju Forest!

response.speaker: Hitotsume Kozou
response.text: And visitors were playing Akitsu Yuugei again. It was wonderful.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "A human man with blue hair"...?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It must have been Ayato.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you mention it, the fan that Ayato chose is the same kind that's used at a festival... Do you think that he knew about the youkai when he decided to hold the Test of Courage here?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh, so my bro Ayato is here for the Test of Courage, too?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Or maybe he's here to catch Onikabuto... Ha, had I known that, I would have brought the one I caught a few days ago to battle him!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, Itto's still clueless about who Ayato really is...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's alright, no need to tell him for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well anyway, seems like all the strange things we saw earlier were caused by these little youkai, not ghosts. What a relief...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And now that we know what was happening, the Test of Courage doesn't seem that scary after all!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey, you want to hang out with humans, right? I totally get that.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: After all, we youkai are becoming a rare breed these days. If all we do is isolate, we'll only feel more lonely. So, why don't you let this oni do ya a favor, hmm?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: See, I'm a youkai too, right, and I'm already a natural in human society. I bet there's not a single person in Inazuma who hasn't heard of Arataki "The One and Oni" Itto!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hahaha! C'mon, let's go! I'll show you around!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that Paimon doesn't feel so scared anymore, maybe we can walk around the area?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The youkai said they wanted to host a festival, but Paimon was too busy having the bejeebers scared out of her to pay any attention until now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come to think of it, Paimon remembers seeing some festival-related items on the beach... Let's head over there and take a look. Maybe we can help out!

choices.text: Maybe we can help you.

talks.objective: Go to the site of Akitsu Yuugei

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Hey there! Congrats on winning the first round of the Test of Courage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thoma! Wait, were you also a contestant in the first round?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I sure was! But I couldn't shake this constant feeling that someone was secretly following me the entire round.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: He didn't seem to be from the Yashiro Commission, and I was concerned that he might be out to stir up trouble at the event, so I tried to capture him.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I didn't expect him to run so fast. I gave chase for a while, but I couldn't keep up... and before I knew it, the round was over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, is there a chance he wasn't there to cause trouble? Maybe he was just trying to scare people.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Coming all the way to the Test of Courage to scare people? Well, I guess the world is full of all kinds of weirdos...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Anyway, I'm gonna be sure to show everyone my abilities in the second round.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon remembers you once mentioned that you like kaidan...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's right. Once I really get into it, you might find me to be your toughest competitor.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm only kidding, of course. I'm not here for the prizes, just to have fun.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: My lord has granted me a rare vacation, so I'd rather spend my time relaxing than worrying about some contest.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, have you found a partner yet? Would you like to pair up with me?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Thoma.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Really? Thank you.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I can't guarantee we'll be able to win the second round, but I'll do my best to help. Let's give it our best shot!

choices.text: Let me think about it...

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Ah, I understand. Hope you can find the right partner and win the second round.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: You've probably already heard that to win the Grand Narukami Shrine's special prize. You have to win all three rounds.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I'd like to know what the prize is as well... And you're the only one who has that chance now, so go for it!

talks.objective: Go to the site of Akitsu Yuugei

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait! You're the strange lady we met before!

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: ...Oh, it's you two again.

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: I have to say, I'm impressed by your willingness to approach me after last time. You're much braver than I thought.

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: But I'm not going to let you off the hook so easily this time. If you don't leave, I'll—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph! Nice try, but you don't scare us anymore!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We just met your fellow youkai, and they told us everything!

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: Huh? Fellow youkai?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! You're another little youkai who lives in the wilderness, aren't you? We just met Youko, Kappa, and Hitotsume Kozou!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So which type of youkai are you? Let Paimon guess... uh... hmm, actually Paimon has no idea what you are!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, it doesn't matter. We're on our way to play Akitsu Yuugei, care to join us?

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: Akitsu Yuugei, again that game...

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: How could this be happening now? All I needed was a little more time, and I could...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What's the matter? Are you not feeling well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Maybe you're hungry? Or maybe you didn't sleep well? You look pretty exhausted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Itto has already taken your fellow youkai to meet some new friends! Everyone will get along just fine.

choices.text: Itto's showing some of his better qualities this time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, so there's no need to worry. C'mon, let's go play Akitsu Yuugei!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll see who can finish the game the quickest. The loser will have to grant the winner a wish!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, it's starting! Get ready!

choices.text: We're your friends, too.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, will you pair up with me for the Test of Courage?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Sayu.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? You're willing to be my partner?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Great... But please keep an eye on me, and don't let me fall asleep again.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: It's pretty scary here, but I'm going to face my fears this time.

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Okay... If you want me to be your partner, you can find me here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Amazing! You cleared all the elemental cubes so quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, Paimon thinks we got this in the bag! Alright, it's your turn.

dialogues.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
dialogues.text: ...Okay, watch and learn.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You watch as the lady finishes the game in record speed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #No way, she hit every cube in one shot and finished even faster than you, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon's head is spinning after watching that! Did you see how she did it?

choices.text: I concede.

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: Even if the rules have changed a little, I would never lose to amateurs like you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, you're a youkai... You're the ones who created Akitsu Yuugei.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No wonder you were so good... Anyway, we'll keep our word; you can make a wish now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But before you say anything, we won't do anything that's clearly impossible or harmful to others.

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: A wish, huh? Then I wish...

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: ...that we never cross paths again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what? But didn't we just have a great time together?

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: That's precisely why...

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: Don't ever come near me or speak to me again.

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: Surely that's a wish you can fulfill, right?

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: This is my final word of warning. If I ever see your faces again, I will, uh... I'll steal your souls!

response.speaker: Hanyuuda Chizuru
response.text: Scared now? Good, then don't come here again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, Paimon doesn't get it... Did we do something wrong?

choices.text: Maybe she just wants to be left alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Fair enough... But Paimon had a lot of fun playing Akitsu Yuugei with her! It would be great if we could see her again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, let's go see how Itto's doing!

choices.text: Everyone has their reasons.
You win.

talks.objective: Return to the site of the Test of Courage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh, hellooo? Miss shrine maiden...? Strange, she isn't here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaaah! What's this? Look, there's something written in red on the bulletin board!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Round 3... Item... Hagoita."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Does this mean that the item we have to find in the third round is a hagoita?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: The shrine maiden appears to be urging us to finish the third round of the Test of Courage.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But where did she go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *gasp* Has she been taken away by a ghost!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will Paimon be next!? *gulp* Oh, Paimon won't ever leave your side now!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: The words are scribbled hastily, but there's no evidence of a struggle. However... aren't there too many words written here?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What did you notice, Heizou?

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I believe that the three items chosen for this three-round contest were each selected by the three organizing parties.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: The Dango Milk was chosen by the merchant who funded the event, and the fan was chosen by the Yashiro Commission, which provided the staff.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: So, does the hagoita, which should have been chosen by the Grand Narukami Shrine, have any unique significance?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's worry about that later. The bigger question is, are we really going to join the third round of the Test of Courage?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would love to win the grand prize, but our safety comes first!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about we... make a tactical retreat!

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I still have my commission to complete, so I'll stay.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Fear arises from mystery, and it's a detective's job to unearth the truth from the mystery.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon somehow feels a little better after hearing you say that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay then, let's wait for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Maybe the shrine maiden had something to take care of and will be back soon...

dialogues.speaker: Shrine Maiden
dialogues.text: Have you found a partner yet?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Heya {NICKNAME}, Paimon! I had a feeling you two would be here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Yoimiya! You're here too?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Mm-hmm. I was also here for the first round, but I arrived a little early, so maybe that's why I didn't see you.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: By the way, I heard you were the winners. Impressive! I eventually found the hidden Dango Milk too, but it was already too late.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Actually, Paimon still doesn't know how we managed to find it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon was just hiding behind {M#him}{F#her} the whole time, and somehow we won!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, you never told me you were so good at this sort of event... You weren't keeping it a secret, were you?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Anyway, would ya like to pair up with me? We'd be an amazing team! With us working together, the second round will be a piece of cake.

choices.text: I want to partner up with Yoimiya.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, awesome! Don't worry, you'll see that being on my team is a blast!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Now let's get out there and win this thing... We'll move faster than a firework shooting straight into the sky! It'll be like WHOOOSHHH and the round will be ours!

choices.text: Let me think about it...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Oh, I understand. You have to put some thought into choosing the best partner... You did already win the first round, after all.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: But I'm definitely no pushover when it comes to the Test of Courage. I've been to loads of these events.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Besides, choosing me means you'll have one less tough competitor to deal with, hehe! Anyway, give it some thought.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: *snoring* Huh? Ah, you found me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Sayu! Are you here for the Test of Courage, too?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Yes... *yawn*

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She looks like she just woke up... No wait, she's actually trying to fall asleep!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: The Test of Courage is too scary, so I keep my eyes closed to not feel scared.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: But as soon as I close my eyes, it's really easy to fall asleep...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: During the first round, a big bull-headed beast leaped out of nowhere and scared me half to death, so I ran and hid behind a tree.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I closed my eyes and tried to hide for a while, but it was really dark and I fell asleep... By the time I woke up, the round was already over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A big bull-headed beast... Wait, that sounds like Ushi!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Now, no one wants to partner up with me for the second round.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, poor Sayu... Wait, but why would you join the Test of Courage in the first place?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, because I heard that being frightened causes you to grow taller...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What kind of silly idea is that!? That's just a load of baloney!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I wasn't sure if it was true, either, but since I heard it could help people grow taller, I decided to give it a shot...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, Sayu doesn't have a partner yet. Should we team up with her?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Sayu.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Really? You're willing to be my partner?

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: Great... But please keep an eye on me, and don't let me fall asleep again.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: It's pretty scary here, but I'm going to face my fears this time.

choices.text: Let me think about it...

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: It's okay, no rush. I came here for my own reasons anyway.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: I'll try to overcome my fear... and sleepiness.

response.speaker: Sayu
response.text: But, if you do want to partner up, just let me know...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: So, made up your mind yet? Do you wanna team up with me?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Yoimiya.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Hehe, awesome! Don't worry, you'll see that being on my team is a blast!

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Now let's get out there and win this thing... We'll move faster than a firework shooting straight into the sky! It'll be like WHOOOSHHH and the round will be ours!

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Ah, really? That's a bummer...

response.speaker: Yoimiya
response.text: Well anyway, I'll be right here if you change your mind!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, want to team up with me?

choices.text: I want to partner up with Thoma.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Really? Thank you.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: I can't guarantee we'll be able to win the second round, but I'll do my best to help. Let's give it our best shot!

choices.text: I still need to give it some more thought.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Ah, not a problem. I still wish you the best of luck, no matter who you chose to team up with.

response.speaker: Thoma
response.text: Just be sure not to put too much pressure on yourself. The Test of Courage is meant to be a fun event, focusing only on winning would defeat the whole purpose of participating.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Something just fell from above! Ah, keep it away from Paimon!!!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Really? Lemme see... Oh! It's some Onikabuto!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hey, did you guys hear that?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Hear what?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: That's strange... How did Paimon transform into a Lavender Melon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Paimon's over here! That doesn't even look like Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm? So, what in the world is this...? Hey, it's flying away. Don't go! Let me have a look at ya!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or is there an eerie shadow over there?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Oh, you're right! That wasn't there when we arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: There's clearly no one around, but there's a shadow on the ground. Oh, this is like a real kaidan story!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... This should be far enough.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Are you tired, Paimon? Do you want to take a break?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hmm? What is this stall doing here? Maybe it's for participants who need a break?

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Excuse me! Three glasses of juice, please...

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Hehe! Don't worry, this time it's on me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yay! Thanks, Yoimiya.

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Uh, excuse me! Anyone here? Strange... seems like no one's around. Guess we'll just have to keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's back again! Maybe it's following us. Ah, help!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: Wow, look at all the lanterns here! It's so beautiful!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: But now that I look closer, it seems like the lanterns are floating in midair. How is that possible?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, that's definitely not normal!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: #Hey {NICKNAME}, can I borrow your shoulders for a second? You can give me a boost and I'll pull one of them down!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No! Now's not the time!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: You want to explore somewhere else? Uh, how about we finish the Test of Courage first!

dialogues.speaker: Yoimiya
dialogues.text: C'mon, let's go. We can't let anyone beat us to it!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Something just fell from above...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I can hear your teeth chattering, Paimon. You must be really scared.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I understand, I'm scared too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Paimon's teeth aren't chattering.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: But I heard a rattling sound... Was that not you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's definitely not Paimon! Wait... It seems to be coming from inside the shrine!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's something over there...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: It's so dark here. It's hard to make out anything.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: It's so dim that Paimon almost looks like a flying Lavender Melon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, that's not Paimon! It doesn't look anything like me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's over here!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ah! It's a... Lavender Melon ghost!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, is it just Paimon, or is there an eerie shadow over there?

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Ah... You're right... Run!

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: I usually like to hide here and take a nap...

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Don't worry. There doesn't appear to be anything scary here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been running for so long that Paimon's starting to get thirsty.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh look, there's a stall set up. Let's go buy something to drink.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Good idea!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello? Anyone here? Strange, there's nobody around.

dialogues.speaker: Sayu
dialogues.text: Oh, I dunno... This stall looks kinda spooky.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Waaaah! You're right, it's starting to creep Paimon out! Let's just get outta here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's back again! Maybe it's following us. Ah, help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, another stall? It sure looks familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, this is the same stall we saw earlier!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's b—b—back again! Maybe it's following us!

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'm not sure whose stall this is, but pestering people to buy your stuff is definitely a poor business practice...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Good thing these lanterns are here, they sure make the path a lot brighter.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You think so? Paimon thinks they look a little spooky...

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Haha, I don't think there's any reason to worry.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Despite what the lanterns look like, whoever placed them here probably didn't mean any harm.

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Believe me, there's plenty of other options if they intended to cause us harm. Alright, let's continue, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: Wait, where are you going?

dialogues.speaker: Thoma
dialogues.text: I'm feeling a little worn out myself, let's stop and take a break for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, the second round of the Test of Courage is about to begin.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Paimon wonders if the shrine maiden knows anything about what Heizou told us... Let's go ask her.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hahaha! I've gotcha now!
Ah, just run! Don't worry about me!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Hah! Don't underestimate this oni! None of you are getting away today!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, it's Itto! It looks like he captured those three we were looking for!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go see!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You get separated from your partner during the Test of Courage
